acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
DIA method covered a mass range from m/z 350 Th up to m/z 1100 Th with 12 Th window width and 1 Th overlap.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein alkylation was performed by adding 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) in LC-MS water to 10 mM final concentration in the reaction mixture.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Protein alkylation was performed by adding 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) in LC-MS water to 10 mM final concentration in the reaction mixture.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protease digestion was performed by addition of 27 µl of 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 0.74 nmol/µl trypsin in LC-MS water and reaction mixture was homogenized per voxel.

fractionation_method.evidence: The Pierce™ High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit was used to fractionate pooled sample (approx. 10 ul of each voxel digest) into 8 fractions according to manufacturer guidelines.
